## Validation

List the exact commands, environments, and manual checks completed. Attach only
redacted evidence.

## Checklist

- [ ] Acceptance criteria are explicit and testable.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior and important failure paths.
- [ ] Authorization, validation, privacy, and abuse cases were reviewed.
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, private URLs, or sensitive logs are included.
- [ ] Configuration examples and documentation were updated where needed.
- [ ] Database changes have a safe migration and recovery plan.
- [ ] The change can be rolled back or disabled safely.
- [ ] Required CI checks pass and review conversations are resolved.
